Pyramid Pillow USA: A patented ergonomic pillow designed to reduce snoring by improving sleep posture. Worth trying for light snoring; loud snoring with gasping is a reason to see a doctor.

Qronge: Affordable US e-bike brand for commuting and outdoor riding. Compare motor, range and weight against how you'll ride; plan for service.
Quicklly: Online Indian grocery and meal delivery in the US. Handy for spices and staples hard to find in small towns; check delivery areas.
RationAle Brewing: Small-batch non-alcoholic craft beers for drinking in moderation. A good option for sober-curious nights and designated drivers.
Ravin Crossbows (US): Premium compact crossbows known for speed and accuracy. Top-tier hunting gear with a price to match; check your state's crossbow season rules.
Red Spectrum LLC: A business services provider. Network details are thin; ask what's included before signing up.
Regal Hotels(GLOBAL): Luxury hotels in Hong Kong with 8,200+ rooms and 60 restaurants and bars. Book direct for member rates if you're traveling to Hong Kong.
Regina Andrew Detroit: Luxury lighting, decor and furniture from a 25-year husband-and-wife design brand. Statement pieces for a finished room; trade pricing exists for designers.
ReGlow: Premium anti-aging skincare built around wrinkle care at home. Patch-test and introduce actives slowly.
RELX Global: A large global e-cigarette brand with pod devices and flavor pods. 21+, and check what's legal to sell and ship in your state.
retouch4me: AI plugins that automate portrait retouching steps like skin cleanup, blemish removal and texture. Big time-saver for portrait photographers; works inside Photoshop and Lightroom.
REVO: Trending wellness gadgets like Face Genie, walking pads, massage guns and smart cupping. Fun to try; read reviews on each device.
Rewarx Studio AI: AI-generated product photos for online stores without paying for a shoot. Good for quick listings; real photos still win for handmade goods and glass.
Rexing Inc: Dash cams, wireless CarPlay displays and car accessories. A dash cam pays for itself in one disputed accident; get one with a front and rear camera.
RKIN: Whole-house water filters, reverse osmosis systems and portable purifiers, with renter-friendly options. Test your water first to buy the right system.
Roborock Amazon Seller: Roborock robot vacuums and mops sold through Amazon. Strong mapping and mopping; compare Amazon price against Roborock direct.
ROBOTIME (US): Rokr and Robotime 3D wooden puzzles, mechanical models and DIY miniature kits. A great adult hobby gift; check difficulty level.
ROCKBROS: Affordable, lightweight cycling gear: bags, lights, helmets and accessories. Strong value for commuters; this storefront is German, so US buyers should use ROCKBROS US.
Rowabi: Handmade rattan and contemporary pendant lights from a US family business. Natural texture for kitchens and porches; check hardwiring vs plug-in.
Roycederm US: Herbal formulas for scalp and skin issues like dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis and psoriasis-prone skin. See a dermatologist if symptoms are severe.
Run For Freedom: A Southern California 5K/10K with a nationwide virtual option, supporting an anti-trafficking cause. Easy way to run for a reason from anywhere.
SAILO, INC: Online booking for boat rentals and yacht charters worldwide. Fun for bachelorette trips and vacations; check what's included (captain, fuel, cleaning).
Satavi Naturals: Spa-style home products like diffusers and bath goods. Nice self-care gifts.
The SBLA neck-sculpting wand and skincare designed for aging gracefully. A cult tool; results depend on consistent use.
ScholarshipOwl (US): A platform that matches students to scholarships and speeds up applications. Never pay to apply for a scholarship itself; check what the subscription adds.
Scorpify: Stylish, giftable phone and AirPods cases. Check device model compatibility.
Seeds & Clones: 200+ clone strains and 600+ seed strains shipped as hemp genetics. Know your state and local cultivation rules before ordering live plants.
SELDOM SEEN STYLES: Premium apparel with strong reviews and repeat buyers. Check the size chart before ordering.
SentryPC: Computer monitoring, content filtering and screen-time control for parents and employers. Tell employees about monitoring and follow your state's laws.
Serika: Modern, thoughtfully designed intimate wellness products. Tasteful gift-guide brand; 18+.
Patio and outdoor furniture with high-value sets. Check weatherproofing and cushion fabric before buying for a humid climate.
Session Goods: Minimalist bongs, pipes, stash kits and bundles that look like homewares. Good filtration without a novelty dragon on the shelf, and the easiest glass on this site to clean.
ShadowGPS: GPS trackers for vehicles, equipment and family. Useful for farm equipment and trailers; tracking other people's vehicles without consent is illegal.
Shakti Warrior: Yoga apparel and accessories from a community-driven yoga brand. Comfortable studio wear.
SharkNinja UK: SharkNinja's UK store for vacuums, cookers, blenders and beauty tools. UK only; US shoppers should use the US site.
SHARLOMAY LTD: GOLDENMATE LiFePO4 batteries and power stations. Compare capacity and warranty against other LiFePO4 brands.
Simple Project smart toilets, bidets and bathroom fixtures. Check rough-in size and electrical needs before ordering.
Shenzhen Feinuote Electronic Technology: Phone cases and mobile accessories at low prices. Check your exact phone model.
Working engine model kits, from mini V8s to steam engines. A unique gift for mechanically minded people.
Shenzhen MaiQiWei Technology Co., Ltd: Factory-direct beauty machines for salons and spas, including private label. For business buyers, not home users.
Shoes NEXBIE: 3D-printed sneakers and slippers from Creality's Nexbie with free shipping and 30-day returns. A fun conversation piece; check sizing.
Shortcut Chat Affiliate Program: An AI app that sends one prompt to multiple models side by side, including Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Useful for comparing answers before you trust one.
Sicotas: Design-forward furniture for modern American homes. Check dimensions and assembly before ordering.
Silver Brush: Premium artist brushes since 1991 for watercolor, acrylic, oil and gouache. Teacher- and pro-trusted; a great gift for painters.
Simbye: Travel eSIMs for 190+ countries, unlimited data in 50+ destinations, plus real phone numbers for calls and verification texts. Handy when you need a number abroad.
Simpletics: Natural hair styling products like Himalayan sea salt spray and texturizing powder. Easy volume without a heavy feel.
SimpliSafe Home Security: DIY home security systems with optional 24/7 professional monitoring and no long contracts. Easy for renters to install and take with them.
SIRUI: Tripods, anamorphic lenses and camera accessories for photographers and filmmakers. Their anamorphic lenses are a budget way into a cinematic look.
Skin Beauty Solutions: Skincare with targeted ingredients for common skin concerns. Patch-test new products.
Skylark Travel Group: Curated luxury hotel bookings with perks and personalized service. Compare the included perks (breakfast, credits, upgrades) against booking direct.
Sleep & Beyond: Certified organic cotton and wool bedding, comforters and pillows. Wool sleeps cooler than people expect; a good pick for hot sleepers.
Smile Makers Collection: Playful, design-led sexual wellness products sold in mainstream retailers. Approachable for first-timers; 18+.
Smoke Cartel: One of the largest online headshops, with 5,000+ glass, vape and accessory products. When Pixie's Pantry doesn't stock the shape you want, this is where the breadth is.
Snow Joe® + Sun Joe®: Affordable electric snow blowers, pressure washers, mowers and yard tools. Great value for regular homeowners; electric means no gas or oil changes.
SOJOS VISION: Affordable sunglasses, prescription glasses and blue light glasses. Trendy frames on a budget.
Southwest Airlines Rapid Rewards - Point: Official portal for buying Southwest Rapid Rewards points. Only worth it in a bonus sale for a specific trip; Southwest points are fixed-value.
Sparkle GmbH: Hey Happiness timeless jewelry from Germany. Ships from Europe; check delivery time and duties.
SquishyZ: Colorful, squishy comfort shoes and slides. Easy everyday footwear.
StarSleep: Home care products for seniors and people with limited mobility, built for safe transfers and independence. A big help for caregivers; check weight limits and room fit.
Still Wild Affiliate Program: Handmade freshwater pearl and gold-filled jewelry in small batches. Relaxed, everyday pieces; ships from Canada.
Stirlingkit: Stirling engine models and accessories. A neat desk piece for science lovers.
StitchLeash: Modular, customizable dog leashes and walking accessories. Practical and good-looking for daily walks.
Storeclaw: AI tools for building and running online stores, with free starter credits. Try it free before subscribing.
Storz&Bickel: The German vaporizer maker behind the Volcano, Mighty+, Venty and Crafty+, built under an ISO 13485 medical-device quality system. Expensive, and worth it; the Volcano outlives everything else in the room.
Straight Talk: Prepaid phone plans on Verizon's network sold through Walmart and online. Solid coverage in rural areas; compare plan prices.
Strong eSIM Affiliate Program: Global eSIM data in 190+ countries for travelers and remote workers. Compare price per gigabyte for your route.
Stuart Trevor UK: Sustainable streetwear and reworked vintage from All Saints' founder. Ships from the UK.
Stuhrling: Affordable automatic and quartz watches with frequent deep promotions. Strong value for a first automatic watch; never pay the 'list' price.
Sunaofe US: Standing desks and ergonomic chairs for remote workers and gamers. Check height range and weight capacity.
Sunjoy Group (US): Ready-to-assemble gazebos, pergolas, outdoor furniture and overlanding accessories. Check wind and snow ratings before anchoring one in an open yard.
SUNNY PIONEER LIMITED: Grand Patio outdoor furniture: chairs, umbrellas and dining sets. Good value; check cushion fabric for humid climates.
SuperBox: Android TV boxes for home streaming. Use them with streaming services you're licensed to watch.
Supplies Outlet: Compatible printer ink and toner cartridges at lower prices than name brands. Big savings for label and paperwork printing; match your printer model exactly.
Survive X US: Professional-grade first-aid and trauma kits. One for the truck and one for the shop is smart rural planning.
sweetcrispy: Budget office chairs, desks and home furniture. Good value; check weight capacity.
T3 Micro: Premium hair dryers, flat irons and curling irons. Pricier than drugstore tools but built to last and gentler on hair.
Tactical X Gear: An EMS ab stimulator that contracts core muscles electrically. A supplement to exercise, not a replacement.
Talkroute Affiliate Program: A virtual business phone system with calls, texting and video from your existing phone. A professional line without a second phone.
Tameson (US): Valves, fittings and industrial supplies with detailed technical info. Useful for irrigation, aquaponics and shop plumbing projects.
Tantaly: Adult products sold with discreet shipping. 18+; read materials and care instructions.
